title: Shared definitions
description: Building blocks reused by the candidate, event and verification formats.

event_id.description: YYYY-MM-DD-<venue-id>-<title-slug>, lowercase, hyphens only. The same event must always get the same id.

when.description: ISO 8601 with Europe/London offset (2026-10-16T22:00:00+01:00), or a bare date (2026-10-16) when the source gives no time.

subcategory.description: What kind of event. Each category allows its own set (enforced by scripts/validate.py): nights-music: club-night, gig, dj-bar, queer-party, cabaret-drag, karaoke, jazz, open-mic, folk-acoustic, in-store, festival, other. arts: theatre, comedy, film, exhibition, talk, dance, performance, other. food-drink: supper-club, pop-up, tasting, special-menu, cookery-class, food-market, food-festival, opening, quiz, other. community: market, fair, workshop, family, outdoors, sport, talk, volunteering, open-studios, tour, festival, other.

venue_id.description: id from data/sources/<category>.json, or null if the venue is not in the registry yet.

known.description: False when the source states no price. Never guess.

fields.description: Which record fields this quote supports, e.g. ['starts_at','price']. 'venue' covers venue.*, 'price' covers price.*.

quote.description: One contiguous snippet copied word for word from the page, 10 to 300 characters. Never stitch separate bits together; use one evidence item per snippet. On a page listing several events, a quote backing a date, time or price should include the event's title or sit right next to it.

source_kind.description: primary = venue's own site or the ticket page for this event; aggregator = a listings site that copies others; reader-tip = sent in by a reader.

ticket_url.description: Link to buy tickets or the event page. Web links only.
